adjudication.rationale: In packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/requestReschedule.handler.ts the new code sets `destinationCalendar` to `bookingToReschedule?.destinationCalendar ? [bookingToReschedule?.destinationCalendar] : []`, with no fallback to `user.destinationCalendar` (or `bookingToReschedule?.user?.destinationCalendar`). This differs from sibling handlers in the same diff (e.g., confirm.handler.ts and editLocation.handler.ts) which explicitly fall back to the user’s destinationCalendar. As written, reschedule-request events will get `[]` when the booking has no destinationCalendar, unlike other flows.
